It was founded on 5 April 1974 by [[R. Thyagarajan (industrialist)|R. Thyagarajan]], [[AVS Raja]] and T. Jayaraman.{{Cite web|title=R Thyagarajan, Shriram Ventures Ltd: Profile and Biography|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/profile/person/17262981|access-date=2020-09-08|website=Bloomberg.com|language=en}}{{cite web|title=About the Group|url=https://www.shriramcapital.com/}} The group had its beginning in [[chit fund]]s business and later on entered the lending and insurance businesses. ==Companies== *Shriram Finance is the flagship company of the group which provides financial services such as commercial vehicle finance, passenger vehicle finance, [[small and medium enterprise|SME]] finance and retail lending ([[personal loans]], gold loans and two-wheeler loans).{{cite news |title=Corporate Presentation/Investor updates of Shriram Finance Limited |url=https://cdn.shriramfinance.in/uploads/investor/pdf/BSENSE(2).pdf |access-date=19 December 2022 |work=Shriram Finance}} It was formed in 2022 as the result of a merger{{cite news |title=Shriram Capital, Shriram City Union Finance to merge with Shriram Transport Finance |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/mergers-acquisitions/shriram-capital-to-merge-with-shriram-transport-finance-9587601.html |access-date=19 December 2022 |work=Moneycontrol |language=en}} of Shriram City Union Finance{{cite news |title=Shriram City Union Finance aims over Rs 6,000 cr disbursement in Q4 |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/shriram-city-union-finance-aims-over-rs-6-000-cr-disbursement-in-q4-121020301883_1.html |access-date=11 April 2021 |work=Business Standard India |date=3 February 2021}}{{cite news |last1=Balachandar |first1=G. |title=Aided by two-wheeler loans, Shriram City sees strong growth in Q3 disbursements |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/aided-by-two-wheeler-loans-shriram-city-sees-strong-growth-in-q3-disbursements/article33328427.ece |access-date=11 April 2021 |work=@businessline |language=en}} and Shriram Capital into Shriram Transport Finance.{{cite news |title=India's largest commercial vehicle financier Shriram Transport sees 73% loan repayments in August |url=https://www.businesstoday.in/current/corporate/india-largest-commercial-vehicle-financier-shriram-transport-sees-73-loan-repayments-in-august/story/415133.html |access-date=11 April 2021 |work=www.businesstoday.in}} In December 2025, it was announced that Shriram Finance had entered into an investment agreement under which the [[Japan]]-headquartered [[MUFG Bank]] would acquire a 20% stake in the company via a preferential share allotment. The transaction, valued at around US$4.3 billion, was subject to regulatory approval and involved Shriram Finance’s principal shareholders.{{Cite web |last=Gullapalli |date=2025-12-22 |title=MUFG Bank to acquire 20% stake in India's Shriram Finance for $4.3bn |url=https://www.retailbankerinternational.com/news/mufg-shriram-finance/ |access-date=2025-12-22 |website=Future Banking |language=en-US}} *Shriram Life Insurance is the [[life insurance]] arm of the group, and a joint venture between Shriram Group and South African company [[Sanlam]].{{cite news |title=Sanlam to up stake in Shriram Life to 49% |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/sanlam-to-up-stake-in-shriram-life-to-49/article22506677.ece |access-date=11 April 2021 |work=@businessline |language=en}} *Shriram General Insurance is engaged in commercial and retail [[vehicle insurance]], [[home insurance]] and [[travel insurance]]. It is a joint venture between Shriram Group and Sanlam.{{cite news |last1=Srivats |first1=K. R. |title=Shriram General Insurance on expansion spree |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/shriram-general-insurance-on-expansion-spree/article26283133.ece |access-date=11 April 2021 |work=@businessline |language=en}} *Shriram Capital (formerly Shriram Financial Ventures) is the [[holding company]] and [[Corporate promoter|promoter]] of Shriram Group's financial services and insurance businesses.{{cite news |last1=Jacob |first1=Shine |title=Shriram Financial Ventures to be holding company in Shriram Group recast |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/finance/shriram-financial-ventures-to-be-holding-company-in-shriram-group-recast-122112300796_1.html |access-date=19 December 2022 |work=Business Standard |date=23 November 2022 |language=en}} It is jointly owned by Shriram Ownership Trust (59.3%) and Sanlam Group (40.7%).{{cite news |last1=Ramesh |first1=M. |title=Shriram group: Believes 'retail ARC' is a blue ocean, kicks-off with ₹300-cr investment |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/shriram-group-believes-retail-arc-is-a-blue-ocean-kicks-off-with-300-cr-investment/article68656441.ece |access-date=23 February 2025 |work=BusinessLine |date=18 September 2024 |language=en}} *Shriram Properties is a real estate developer focusing on mid-income housing projects, primarily in [[South India]].{{cite news |last1=Sonavane |first1=Ravindra N. |title=Shriram Properties files draft papers to raise ₹800 crore via IPO |url=https://www.livemint.com/market/ipo/shriram-properties-files-drhp-to-raise-800-crore-via-ipo-11618026406956.html |access-date=11 April 2021 |work=mint |date=10 April 2021 |language=en}} * Shriram Fortune is the financial services distribution arm of the group.{{cite news |title=Shriram Capital mulls merger of group cos to facilitate exit of Piramal Group and TPG |url=https://www.thenewsminute.com/article/shriram-capital-mulls-merger-group-cos-facilitate-exit-piramal-group-and-tpg-111408 |access-date=11 April 2021 |work=The News Minute |date=30 October 2019 |language=en}} *Shriram AMC is an [[asset management company]] focused on mutual funds.{{cite news |title=Shriram AMC to launch two new schemes in current fiscal |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/mf/mf-news/shriram-amc-to-launch-two-new-schemes-in-current-fiscal/articleshow/49291986.cms |access-date=11 April 2021 |work=The Economic Times}} *Shriram Insight is a retail stockbroker. *Shriram Wealth provides [[wealth management]] advisory services. *Shriram Automall is a [[Auto auction|vehicle auction]] platform started as a subsidiary of Shriram Transport Finance. In 2018, [[CarTrade.com|CarTrade]] acquired a majority stake in Shriram Automall.{{cite news |last1=Thakkar |first1=Ketan |title=CarTrade acquires 51 per cent in Shriram Automall to create India's largest online vehicle transaction platform |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/cartrade-acquires-51-per-cent-in-shriram-automall-to-create-indias-largest-online-vehicle-transaction-platform/articleshow/62634517.cms |access-date=3 December 2021 |work=The Economic Times |date=25 January 2018}} Shriram Finance holds a 44.56% stake in Shriram Automall, as of 2024.{{cite news |title=Shriram Finance |url=https://www.icra.in/Rationale/ShowRationaleReport/?Id=127640 |access-date=30 May 2024 |work=ICRA}} ==Former companies== * Shriram Housing Finance was a [[home loan]] company which was a subsidiary of Shriram City Union Finance (and subsequently Shriram Finance).{{cite news |title=Shriram City Union Finance may seek investor for housing unit |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/shriram-city-union-finance-may-seek-investor-for-housing-unit/articleshow/81307005.cms |access-date=11 April 2021 |work=The Economic Times}} In 2024, [[Warburg Pincus]] acquired Shriram Housing Finance for {{INR}}4,630 crore{{cite news |title=US fund Warburg to buy Shriram Housing Finance |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/us-fund-warburg-to-buy-shriram-housing-finance/articleshow/110094161.cms |access-date=30 May 2024 |work=The Times of India |date=14 May 2024}} and renamed the company as Truhome Finance.{{cite news |last1=Ray |first1=Atmadip |title=Shriram Housing becomes Truhome Finance, eyes 30% annual growth |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/shriram-housing-becomes-truhome-finance-eyes-30-annual-growth/articleshow/117271422.cms |access-date=23 February 2025 |work=The
